decisions.reason: By 2022 this capital-intensive underground loader line has had enough time to reveal its prospects, and its disappearance from later website observations suggests weak traction relative to the cost of keeping the option open.

The underground dump-truck line shares core capabilities but, after several years and no later website evidence, management would likely judge that uncertainty has largely resolved without enough payoff to justify further commitment.
As a single construction dumper introduced outside the firm's strongest differentiated niches, it offers limited option value after three years if customer uptake has not become clearly visible.

This inclined furniture-lift line is a relatively asset-light niche extension of the firm's lifting know-how, so management would likely keep it while preserving the option to serve specialized demand.
The inclined building-material-lift line fits the firm's lifting and construction applications and can likely be maintained at modest cost, making it worth keeping as a still-viable niche option.
The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is a narrower and likely costlier derivative, so if sales have not clearly validated it by 2022 management would be inclined to redeploy resources elsewhere.
